name: navigator-pece
description: Opatruj: péče o blízké s demencí (deník, podklady pro úřady, vývoj stavu)

scripts.emulators: cross-env KLASIFIKACE_MOCK=1 FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore,storage
scripts.test:retezec: cross-env KLASIFIKACE_MOCK=1 FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=60 firebase emulators:exec --only auth,functions,firestore,storage "vitest run tests/integration"
scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules && npm run test:retezec
